name: Population by educational attainment and NUTS 2 region (edat_lfse_04)

measures.definition: Share of people aged 25 to 64 whose highest level of education is tertiary (ISCED 2011 levels 5 to 8), in the NUTS 2 region around the city, from the EU Labour Force Survey.

coverage.geography: EU, EFTA, candidate countries; the UK to 2019

rights.edition: edat_lfse_04, ISCED 5-8, ages 25-64, latest year (2025 for most regions)
rights.attribution: Source: Eurostat, EU Labour Force Survey (edat_lfse_04, © European Union). Borgo keeps each region's latest value
notices: Eurostat is not responsible for Borgo's use of its data.

vetted.notes: One survey and one definition for every region; the region is wider than the city except where they coincide (Berlin, Hamburg, Vienna, Prague, Budapest, Brussels). Not fetched on demand: finding a place's NUTS 2 region needs a boundary lookup not built yet.

caveats: A region such as Piemonte or Lombardia includes towns and countryside, so it reads lower than its main city.
